instruction: Look at guih15_sheet_metal_flat_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Complete the hard sheet-metal flat pattern. Draw OUTLINE closed profile through (0,35), (60,35), (60,0), (200,0), (200,35), (260,35), (260,135), (200,135), (200,170), (60,170), (60,135), and (0,135). Add BEND lines (60,0)-(60,170), (200,0)-(200,170), (0,35)-(260,35), and (0,135)-(260,135). Add HOLE circles radius 5 at (35,85), (225,85), (130,35), and (130,135), RELIEF circles radius 4 at (60,35), (60,135), (200,35), and (200,135), and notes BEND 90 UP, BEND 90 DOWN, 4X Ø10, and K=0.38 T=2.0. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih15_sheet_metal_flat_completed.dxf. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
